test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution: TB Solution: The correct answer is **with**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • With means **having or carrying something.** (किसी वस्‍तु को साथ लिए) -Example: The event was a fantastic success **with** students dancing, rapping and performing poetry against racism. • **“With"** is the **preposition** that refers to something together. • **'with'** is usually used to say that you support a person and their opinion. ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **"Above"** means **in a higher place.** It can be used as a preposition or adverb. • **"Until"** means **up to the time or the event mentioned.** It can be used as a preposition and conjunction. • **"Upon"** means **a more formal term for on, especially in abstract senses.** It is a preposition. Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is** 'with'.** 43:Te7f,
